title: Quantitative Uniqueness of Kantorovich Potentials
summary: This paper studies the uniqueness of solutions to the dual optimal transport problem, both qualitatively and quantitatively (bounds on the diameter of the set of optimisers). On the qualitative side, we prove that when one marginal measure's support is rectifiably connected (path-connected by rectifiable paths), the optimal dual potentials are unique up to a constant.
